note: The fuzzer passes the attacker-controlled input buffer and its exact length into libass.
The input length is preserved as bufsize and used to allocate/copy a NUL-terminated buffer for parsing.
The copied buffer is handed to the subtitle parser, which builds internal structures from the input text.

The hash helper assumes string members have a valid non-empty buffer; zero-length string views violate the safety obligation that the hash input length must be positive before dereferencing the buffer.
When len is zero, the do-while still dereferences the buffer pointer, causing an invalid read on an empty string.
